Bot vs bot: average score for the row bot against the column bot

Finish order: winner first, then later elimination turn in completed games. Timed-out games count as ties (0.5 for each bot). n counts completed or timed-out games; turn-limit and error results are excluded. Cell tooltips include an approximate 95% Jeffreys-prior credible interval for average score (normal approximation). Hover over a player for their completed and timed-out games at that size. Cells with n<MINN are faded. Source: deduplicated master_results.sgl; pre-stalemate Doomstack results are labeled challenger; pre-2026-10-23 Actuary games are excluded. Valid pre-safety-fix games are pooled with the same strategy; legacy strategy versions remain separate. The validated 2026-11-09 fixed-budget representative study was imported on 2026-11-12; this pooled matrix is not its standalone win-rate ranking.
  Ties included as half a point; percentages are scores, not outright win percentages.
